options: A private HashiCorp-only list of provider plugins
A public catalog, at registry.terraform.io, of published and versioned reusable modules
A tool for formatting .tf files
A database where terraform state is stored remotely
questions.explain: The Terraform Registry hosts thousands of published, versioned modules that teams can call instead of writing their own.

questions.q: What format does a registry module's source address use?
options: A relative filesystem path starting with ./
<namespace>/<name>/<provider>, e.g. terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws
A full HTTPS URL to a GitHub repository, always
Just the module's name with no other parts
questions.explain: Registry addresses follow <namespace>/<name>/<provider>, with no leading ./ since it isn't a filesystem path.

questions.q: When does Terraform download a registry module's files?
options: During terraform init, the same step that resolves a local module's source
Only during terraform destroy
Automatically every time terraform plan runs, even with no changes
Registry modules are never downloaded; they execute remotely
questions.explain: terraform init resolves and downloads registry modules, just as it resolves local module sources and provider plugins.

questions.q: How are a registry module's outputs read elsewhere in a configuration?
options: With a special registry() function
They cannot be read outside the module
With the same module.<name>.<output> syntax used for a hand-written local module
Only through a separate data source block
questions.explain: A registry module behaves exactly like a local module once called — its documented outputs use the same module.<name>.<output> reference.

questions.q: What does this lesson recommend checking before adopting a registry module into real infrastructure?
options: Nothing — registry modules are pre-verified and safe to use without review
Only its download count
Its documented inputs/outputs, source repository, and how recently it's maintained, since it's still someone else's code running in your account
Whether it has a title slide
questions.explain: A registry module is still external code executing against your cloud account, so its documentation and maintenance history are worth reviewing first.
